Every day for 30 days

Each evening at your check-in time (${global:checkin_time,20:00}, 24-hour clock) the Daily Check-in opens. It stays open until the next check-in, and the app reminds you every two hours for the rest of the evening until you answer it. Tap Show Surveys on the home page to answer it. It asks where you are in your menstrual cycle, which symptoms you are having today, and how severe each of those symptoms is.


Ovulation tests

The study team has set the days you take an ovulation predictor kit (OPK) test. On each of those days the Ovulation Test survey opens in the morning, and the app reminds you three times during the day until you answer it.


Take the test, then tap Show Surveys on the home page and open Ovulation Test. Enter whether the test was positive or negative for the luteinizing hormone (LH) surge, and if it was positive you can add a photo of the strip.


To see how to take the test and read the result, tap How to Use an Ovulation Test on the home page.
